learning_outcomes.text: To understand the concept and principle of network technologies, including methods of data transmission.
Students are able to identify, apply and solve tasks in the field of network technologies.

syllabus_topics: Layers and protocols of the TCP/IP protocol model.
Security of network devices and security in LAN networks.
Safety in laboratories. Basic information about the subject and its classification.
Laboratory work – practical building of a computer network.
Laboratory work – static and default routing.
Laboratory work – routing and routing protocols (OSPFv2).
Laboratory work – routing and routing protocols (OSPFv3).
Laboratory work – switches in a computer network, VLAN networks.
Laboratory work - security of network devices and security in LAN networks.
Laboratory work – redundancy in computer networks.
